title: Klaviyo Pricing Review 2026: Real Costs at Every List Size (Is It Worth It?)

facts.fact: Klaviyo's Email plan lists at about $20 per month for 500 contacts, with 5,000 sends included, according to the reviewer's table.
facts.quote: | 500 contacts | ~$20/mo | 5,000 sends | $40 |

facts.fact: Klaviyo's Email plan lists at about $100 per month for 5,000 contacts, with 50,000 sends included, according to the reviewer's table.
Klaviyo's Email plan lists at about $400 per month for 25,000 contacts, with 250,000 sends included, according to the reviewer's table.
Klaviyo's Email plan lists at about $720 per month for 50,000 contacts, with 500,000 sends included, according to the reviewer's table.
Klaviyo's Email plan lists at about $1,380 per month for 100,000 contacts, with 1,000,000 sends included, according to the reviewer's table.
The reviewer states that Klaviyo's list prices are billed monthly and that Klaviyo offers no annual discount.
facts.quote: Klaviyo list prices, billed monthly (Klaviyo has no annual discount), verified October 2026.

facts.fact: Klaviyo's free tier is capped at 250 contacts and 500 email sends per month, according to the reviewer.
facts.quote: Klaviyo’s free tier caps at 250 contacts and 500 email sends per month.

facts.fact: Klaviyo's SMS is sold as an add-on at $0.01 per SMS credit plus carrier fees, with the reviewer estimating about $1 per 100 texts before carrier fees.
facts.quote: SMS is an add-on to the Email plan, at $0.01 per SMS credit plus carrier fees (about $1 per 100 texts before carrier fees).

facts.fact: There is no combined Email plus SMS plan at Klaviyo; SMS is an add-on to the Email plan.
facts.quote: There is no combined Email + SMS plan: SMS is an add-on to the Email plan

facts.fact: The reviewer's quick verdict says Klaviyo is worth the premium for ecommerce stores doing more than roughly $10,000 per month in revenue.
facts.unit: USD per month in store revenue
facts.quote: Klaviyo is worth the premium over cheaper alternatives if you’re running an ecommerce store doing more than roughly **$10,000 per month in revenue**

facts.fact: The reviewer says Omnisend is about 20% cheaper than Klaviyo at 5,000 contacts and 30-43% cheaper at 25,000-50,000 contacts.
facts.quote: **Omnisend is about 20% cheaper at 5,000 contacts** (30-43% at 25,000-50,000)

facts.fact: The reviewer says MailerLite costs roughly half of Klaviyo's price for email campaigns plus basic automations.
facts.quote: **MailerLite is roughly half the price** if you just need email campaigns plus basic automations.

facts.fact: In the reviewer's comparison, Mailchimp Standard lists at $100 per month for 5,000 contacts, the same as Klaviyo's Email plan.
In the reviewer's comparison, Mailchimp Standard lists at $450 per month for 50,000 contacts, versus $720 for Klaviyo's Email plan.
The reviewer says MailerLite is 10% cheaper on annual billing, while Klaviyo and Mailchimp have no annual discount.
facts.quote: MailerLite is 10% cheaper on annual billing; Klaviyo and Mailchimp have no annual discount.

facts.fact: The reviewer estimates that stores running a monthly hygiene flow to suppress or delete profiles inactive for 12 months save 15-25% on their next Klaviyo bill.
facts.quote: Most stores running this once save 15-25% on their next Klaviyo bill.

facts.fact: Klaviyo bills on active profiles that may receive marketing emails; unsubscribed and suppressed profiles do not count toward the bill.
facts.quote: Unsubscribed and suppressed profiles don’t count, but every subscribed profile does

facts.fact: The reviewer says Klaviyo's pricing tiers have stepwise jumps at specific contact counts, such as moving from 9,999 to 10,001 contacts into the next tier mid-billing-cycle.
facts.quote: crossing from 9,999 to 10,001 contacts moves you into the next tier mid-billing-cycle

facts.fact: The reviewer says Klaviyo's per-contact cost flattens out at around 25,000 contacts.
facts.quote: The break point where Klaviyo’s per-contact cost flattens out is around 25,000 contacts.

facts.fact: The reviewer says each Klaviyo agency sub-account is priced as its own plan on its own contact count, with no agency discount tier.
facts.quote: each sub-account is priced as its own plan based on its own contact count. There’s no agency discount tier

facts.fact: The reviewer estimates that at 5,000 contacts with 3,000 SMS sends per month, Klaviyo's bill is about $130 per month plus carrier fees.
facts.unit: USD per month plus carrier fees
facts.quote: At 5,000 contacts running modest SMS (3,000 sends per month), that’s about $130/mo plus carrier fees

facts.fact: The reviewer states Klaviyo's Email plan costs about $100/mo for 5,000 contacts, about $400/mo for 25,000, about $720/mo for 50,000, and about $1,380/mo for 100,000.
The reviewer says SMS costs $0.01 per SMS credit on Klaviyo, plus carrier fees, and that 3,000 texts a month adds about $30 before carrier fees.
facts.quote: SMS is extra at $0.01 per SMS credit plus carrier fees (3,000 texts a month adds about $30 before carrier fees).

facts.fact: The reviewer estimates that billing on every emailable profile, engaged or not, will inflate a Klaviyo bill by 15-25% unless a quarterly hygiene flow is run.
facts.quote: Billing on every emailable profile, engaged or not, will inflate your bill 15-25% unless you run a quarterly hygiene flow.

facts.fact: The reviewer reports Omnisend at $81 versus Klaviyo at $100 for 5,000 contacts, and $282 versus $400 for 25,000 contacts.
facts.quote: It undercuts Klaviyo at every contact tier ($81 against $100 at 5,000, $282 against $400 at 25,000)

facts.fact: The reviewer states Omnisend costs about 80% of Klaviyo's price at 5,000 contacts and about 70% at 25,000 contacts.
facts.quote: Omnisend covers the same ecommerce-flow patterns at about 80% of Klaviyo’s price at 5,000 contacts and about 70% at 25,000.

facts.fact: The reviewer says MailerLite costs roughly half of Klaviyo at 5,000 contacts.
facts.quote: MailerLite is roughly half the cost at 5,000 contacts

facts.fact: The reviewer says Customer.io's Essentials plan starts at $100 a month, billed monthly, for 5,000 profiles.
facts.quote: Essentials starts at $100 a month, billed monthly, for 5,000)

facts.fact: The reviewer states Customer.io costs about $280 versus Klaviyo's $400 at 25,000 profiles.
facts.quote: the same or less from 5,000 profiles up (about $280 vs $400 at 25,000)

facts.fact: The reviewer recommends Omnisend for ecommerce stores with store revenue under $50k per month.
facts.unit: USD per month in store revenue
facts.quote: Switch to Omnisend** if you’re under $50k/mo in store revenue

facts.fact: The reviewer recommends MailerLite for businesses under 10,000 contacts that do not use ecommerce-specific flows.
facts.quote: if you’re under 10,000 contacts and you don’t actually use ecommerce-specific flows.

facts.fact: The reviewer says Klaviyo is the right tool for ecommerce stores doing more than $10,000 per month in revenue that actively run abandoned cart and post-purchase flows.
facts.quote: doing more than $10,000/month in revenue, actively running abandoned cart and post-purchase flows.

facts.fact: The reviewer says it re-tests pricing every 90 days against current rate cards.
facts.quote: We re-test pricing every 90 days against current rate cards.

facts.fact: The reviewer's pricing article was last updated on October 14, 2026.
facts.quote: Last updated: October 14, 2026.
